result_text:
The hook's full vitest run fails because of the environment, not my change. `@better-auth/api-key`'s `api-key.test.ts` needs Postgres at 127.0.0.1:5432 and gets `ECONNREFUSED`. Starting one needs Docker (`docker compose up -d`), and Docker isn't installed here.

I ran the tests that exercise the code I touched (`src/api` and `src/utils` in `packages/better-auth`, which cover sign-up, sign-in and email verification). All 19 files pass: 443 tests passed and 1 was skipped. The Postgres-backed suite still needs a run somewhere with a database.
